recognize_zh: 淋巴結 lambda 免疫染色：大量細胞質強棕色陽性的漿細胞環繞並滲入濾泡周圍與濾泡間區，數量明顯多於一般反應性背景，搭配 kappa 染色比較可支持 HHV8 相關 MCD 的 lambda 偏向。
features: Numerous cells with strong cytoplasmic lambda light-chain staining
Positive cells concentrated around and within the periphery of follicles and in interfollicular areas
Positive cells are round with eccentric nuclei, consistent with plasma cells/plasmablasts
Follicle centers show weak diffuse background staining only
Moderate background staining limits assessment of individual cells at this magnification
describe_en: Lymph node section immunostained for lambda light chain shows numerous strongly positive plasmacytoid cells distributed in a band around follicles and throughout interfollicular regions. The follicle centers show only faint background staining. Assessment of light-chain restriction requires side-by-side comparison with kappa, which in this case highlights far fewer cells in the corresponding areas. Findings support a lambda-predominant plasma cell/plasmablast population, consistent with the lambda-restricted plasmablasts characteristic of HHV8-associated multicentric Castleman disease.

ddx.vs: Reactive plasma cells show a kappa-to-lambda ratio of roughly 2:1, whereas this case shows lambda predominance with fewer kappa-positive cells.

ddx.dx: Nodal marginal zone lymphoma with plasmacytic differentiation
ddx.vs: NMZL may be lambda-restricted but shows expanded monotypic marginal zone B cells and lacks HHV8 LANA-1-positive plasmablasts.
Plasmacytoma diffusely effaces the node with monotypic mature plasma cells, whereas here follicular architecture is preserved and the lambda-positive cells are mantle/interfollicular.
